title: Hackathon planning kickoff
description: Test script for the conversation simulator. Juanjo and Enric plan HackBarna 26: dates, venue, sponsors. Trigger labels mark lines a node-producing agent might act on.

lines.speaker: enric
lines.text: yo juanjo

lines.speaker: juanjo
lines.text: eyy, que tal tio

lines.speaker: enric
lines.text: good good, you

lines.speaker: juanjo
lines.text: all good, ready for this

lines.speaker: enric
lines.text: haha let's see

lines.speaker: juanjo
lines.text: okay so, we have to organize a hackathon, where do we start

lines.speaker: enric
lines.text: dates first i guess

lines.speaker: juanjo
lines.text: yeah makes sense

lines.speaker: enric
lines.text: so i was thinking the weekend of the 26th

lines.speaker: juanjo
lines.text: hmm wait, isn't the 24th a holiday here

lines.speaker: enric
lines.text: oh right, la merce, that's a thursday

lines.speaker: juanjo
lines.text: yeah exactly, so people are gonna take the long weekend and leave town

lines.speaker: enric
lines.text: true, nobody's gonna show up the 26th-27th then

lines.speaker: juanjo
lines.text: what about the weekend before, the 19th-20th

lines.speaker: enric
lines.text: mm that could work

lines.speaker: juanjo
lines.text: yeah, before the holiday rush, people are still around

lines.speaker: enric
lines.text: saturday 19th, sunday 20th

lines.speaker: juanjo
lines.text: exactly

lines.speaker: enric
lines.text: okay, locking that in, 19-20 september

lines.speaker: juanjo
lines.text: nice, kan, put that on a calendar with two separate days: Hackathon day 1 on 2026-09-19 and Hackathon day 2 on 2026-09-20

lines.speaker: enric
lines.text: cool, venue next

lines.speaker: juanjo
lines.text: yeah where do we host it

lines.speaker: enric
lines.text: i was thinking glovo, they've got that big office downtown

lines.speaker: juanjo
lines.text: hmm, we could also just repeat last year's spot

lines.speaker: enric
lines.text: which one was that again

lines.speaker: juanjo
lines.text: norrsken, house barcelona, right by the port

lines.speaker: enric
lines.text: oh right, that place was great, good wifi, big kitchen

lines.speaker: juanjo
lines.text: and they already said yes for this year too

lines.speaker: enric
lines.text: okay, kan, can you show them both on a map next to the calendar please? For this mock planning exercise use approximate pins: Glovo at latitude 41.403, longitude 2.194, and Norrsken at latitude 41.375, longitude 2.189. Label both positions as approximate.

lines.speaker: juanjo
lines.text: haha nice, let's see them side by side

lines.speaker: enric
lines.text: norrsken's closer to the metro actually

lines.speaker: juanjo
lines.text: yeah and it's free, glovo would need budget approval

lines.speaker: enric
lines.text: norrsken it is then

lines.speaker: juanjo
lines.text: sponsors, who do we have lined up

lines.speaker: enric
lines.text: vonage confirmed, they're gold sponsor again

lines.speaker: juanjo
lines.text: nice, and cognition's in too right

lines.speaker: enric
lines.text: yep, devin's team, they're bringing mentors

lines.speaker: juanjo
lines.text: nebius said yes as well, for compute credits

lines.speaker: enric
lines.text: don't forget preply, they signed as silver

lines.speaker: juanjo
lines.text: true, kan, add a sponsors table beside the map listing Vonage, Cognition, Nebius and Preply, with the contributions we just discussed

lines.speaker: enric
lines.text:
Kan, capture the plan as editable canvas shapes:
```mermaid
flowchart TD
  Plan["HackBarna 26"] --> Dates["19–20 September"]
  Dates --> Venue["Norrsken House Barcelona"]
  Venue --> Build["Build weekend"]
  Sponsors["Vonage · Cognition · Nebius · Preply"] --> Build
  Mentors["Mentors"] --> Demo["Demos + judging"]
  Build --> Demo
```

lines.speaker: enric
lines.text: solid lineup, i think we have a good start

lines.speaker: juanjo
lines.text: yeah let's sync again tomorrow

lines.speaker: enric
lines.text: sounds good, talk later

lines.speaker: juanjo
lines.text: later!
